coverage.rule: A value from a row whose coverage is under 50% is withheld: null, with a reason next to it.

provenance.definition: Travel time between two stations: median, 95th percentile and buffer time index per time band
sql: select distinct id, name from (select from_station_id as id, from_station_name as name from read_parquet('/Users/akshay/projects/headway/tests/fixtures/gold_snapshot/gold/agg_trip_time_budget.parquet') where line = 'Red' union all select to_station_id, to_station_name from read_parquet('/Users/akshay/projects/headway/tests/fixtures/gold_snapshot/gold/agg_trip_time_budget.parquet') where line = 'Red') order by name, id

select direction_id, time_band, n_trips, n_scheduled_trips, n_excluded_outage, n_implausible, n_disruption, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 and n_trips >= 20 then median_s end, 1) as median_s, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 and n_trips >= 20 then p95_s end, 1) as p95_s, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 and n_trips >= 20 then buffer_time_index end, 3) as buffer_time_index, round(coverage_pct, 1) as coverage_pct from read_parquet('/Users/akshay/projects/headway/tests/fixtures/gold_snapshot/gold/agg_trip_time_budget.parquet') where line = 'Red' and window_label = 'last_7d' and from_station_id = 'place-davis' and to_station_id = 'place-harsq' order by direction_id, case time_band when 'am_peak' then 0 when 'midday' then 1 when 'pm_peak' then 2 when 'evening' then 3 when 'other' then 4 else 9 end, time_band limit 501
